WITH patient_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    p.ID,
    p.SEX,
    AVG(l.WBC) as avg_wbc,
    AVG(l.HGB) / AVG(l.HCT) as ratio
  FROM Laboratory l
  INNER JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
  GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) as mean_ratio
  FROM patient_ratios
  WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  pr.ID,
  pr.SEX,
  pr.avg_wbc,
  pr.ratio,
  pr.ratio - om.mean_ratio as difference
FROM patient_ratios pr
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
WHERE pr.ratio > om.mean_ratio
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The database supports NULLS LAST syntax in ORDER BY (MySQL 8.0+, PostgreSQL, Oracle). For databases that don't support this, remove the NULLS LAST clause or use a CASE expression to order NULLs last.
